name: Papé Machinery Agriculture & Turf
old_description: Find reliable agriculture & turf equipment tailored to your budget.
about:
Papé Machinery Agriculture & Turf operates from its headquarters in Bend, Oregon, as an authorized John Deere dealer with a network spanning six western states. The company runs more than 35 full-service locations across Oregon, Washington, California, Nevada, and Idaho, positioning teams close to customers from the Willamette Valley to the High Desert.

The dealership sells new and used John Deere agriculture equipment — combines, sprayers, tillers, cultivators, and a range of tractors including compact utility models such as the 1025R, 2025R, 3025E, and 4044M. It also carries Stihl and Honda power equipment for residential and commercial use, plus John Deere Gator utility vehicles. Beyond sales, Papé provides parts through the Shop.Deere platform with illustrated diagrams and maintenance kits, and operates service centers offering scheduled maintenance, specials, and on-site support.

Customers include row-crop and specialty farms, commercial landscaping crews, and homeowners. In the Willamette Valley, Smith Bros. Farms relies on Papé for its multi-generational grass-seed operation. Commercial turf buyers access zero-turn and walk-behind mowers, while residential clients purchase chainsaws, trimmers, blowers, generators, and lawn tractors.

Papé emphasizes local availability, stating that its knowledgeable teams are positioned to maximize uptime. Parts orders are backed by dealership staff, and service specials aim to reduce downtime through preventive maintenance.
